steps.message: What is the fastest plan to make 800 TOPS starting 1 April 2026?

reply.answer:
**800 TOPS starting 1 Apr 2026: earliest full delivery is Monday 6 April 2026 (5 calendar days), with all pieces outsourced for 911.00 in external processing charges (currency unspecified).**

| Workshop | Pieces | Batch arrival |
|---|---|---|
| W6 Nimble Needle | 390 | 5 Apr |
| W8 FreshStart | 300 (its cap) | 5 Apr |
| W2 SteadyHands | 110 | 6 Apr |

No in-house production is used. Plan risk is **medium**: about an 88% chance all three batches come back clean; a full-redo scenario would move Nimble Needle to 9 Apr, FreshStart to 10 Apr and SteadyHands to 9 Apr.

Assumptions: new batch (original quantities), inclusive start date, Mon–Sat workdays, capacity and queues from the 2026-04-01 snapshot; cost excludes transport, rework and in-house cost, and dates assume clean batches.

steps.message: Does the fastest plan’s 88% clean-batch estimate mean an 88% chance this order will be delivered on time?

reply.answer:
Not quite — and no deadline was set, so "on time" has nothing to measure against. The 88% figure is only the chance that all three outsourced batches come back clean; if any batch needs rework it delays that batch's pieces, with a full-redo scenario arriving 9–10 April instead of 5–6 April (ordered 1 Apr: W6 Nimble Needle 390, W8 FreshStart 300, W2 SteadyHands 110, completion 6 Apr, 911.00 external charges, from `track1/data/workshops.csv` rows 3, 7 and 9).

Assumptions: new batch at original quantities, calibrated capacity and queues from the 2026-04-01 snapshot, Monday–Saturday workdays; the rework dates are a one-full-redo scenario, not a guaranteed latest arrival.
